# `ViewPlan`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Device-initiated notification of the ViewPlan worker state, with the held plan attached.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (shape only; the terminal-state formatter also persists the plan to storage) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, print_plan_state @0x405ce0, FormatViewPlan @0x404630 (64-bit build); working event OBSERVED once (2026-10-12) |

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver. On the device, the terminal-state callback writes the plan file and a separate reporting record.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"ViewPlan"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | The complete state table. idle is an initial/restored state and is not automatically sent as an event. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | no | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held; no ViewPlan stage literal is established. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | no | - | Present when state is fail. 207 when the worker aborts on a second schedule overlap (see the scheduling chapter). 536 when a start is requested while a ViewPlan/demonstrate sequence is already running (a thread-local error code set by `StartDemonstrate`, guarded by `IsViewPlanRunning`). [READ] |
| `error` | string | no | - | Message for code; present with code when state is fail. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | yes | - | Elapsed milliseconds, signed 32-bit low bits. Running state uses current monotonic minus start; terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Function-parent path when included; may be absent. [READ] |
| `plan` | object | no | - | Added only when the held target list is non-empty. Shape is that of the held plan, not a validator schema. [READ] |
| `plan.plan_name` | string | no | - | [READ] |
| `plan.update_time_seestar` | string | no | - | Only when non-empty. [READ] |
| `plan.plan_target_af` | boolean | no | - | Read from a device setting, not from the held parsed flag; the two can differ. [READ] |
| `plan.viewplan_gohome` | boolean | no | - | Read from a device setting, as for plan_target_af. [READ] |
| `plan.list` | array<object> | no | - | [READ] |
| `plan.list[].state` | string | no | - | Per-target state from the cached Target state. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [READ] |
| `plan.list[].stage` | string | no | - | [READ] |
| `plan.list[].lapse_ms` | integer | no | - | [READ] |
| `plan.list[].code` | integer | no | - | 204 for a skipped target, 513 for a target whose end already passed, 253 cancelled, 537 shutdown. [READ] |
| `plan.list[].error` | string | no | - | [READ] |
| `plan.list[].target_id` | integer | no | - | [READ] |
| `plan.list[].wide_state` | string | no | - | Wide and dual targets only. [READ] |
| `plan.list[].wide_code` | integer | no | - | [READ] |
| `plan.list[].wide_error` | string | no | - | [READ] |
| `plan.list[].output_file` | object | no | - | Main output, `{path, files}` with exactly one file entry. [READ; single-builder origin of every stored object INFERRED] |
| `plan.list[].output_file.path` | string | yes | - | Output directory, relative to the storage root, without a trailing slash. [READ] |
| `plan.list[].output_file.files` | array<object> | yes | - | One object for the saved file; the builder pushes a single entry (no loop). Range: at least 1 item(s). [READ] |

| `plan.list[].wide_output_file.files` | array<object> | yes | - | One object for the saved file; the builder pushes a single entry (no loop). Range: at least 1 item(s). [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, working - Start of a run (shape OBSERVED once; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"ViewPlan","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":0,"plan":{"plan_name":"Example plan","plan_target_af":false,"viewplan_gohome":true,"list":[{"target_id":1790000000,"target_name":"Example target","start_min":1200,"duration_min":90,"skip":false,"camera_mode":"tele","lp_filter":false}]}}
```

Event, failed-second-rollover - Static example of a fail event (READ, not captured):

```json
{"Event":"ViewPlan","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"fail","code":207,"error":"fail to operate","lapse_ms":5}
```
